category: hosted GitHub Actions runner service with CI optimization agents
tier: 7-day or USD 10 trial, then a fixed monthly quote
confidence_note: all values are quoted from the first-party pricing page read on 2026-11-19. Build concurrency, retention and egress are unverified: the page publishes no numbers for them. The speed claims are the vendor's and are not measured here.

free_tier.stated: a 7-day or USD 10 CI usage trial with a card at checkout, nothing charged, then one fixed monthly price quoted from current usage

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-object or build wall-clock cap stated in the first-party pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no number is stated in the first-party pages read

egress.terms: unverified: no egress allowance or price stated on the pricing page

interface_detail: GitHub Actions jobs are routed to Graphide runners by a GitHub App; an AI agent tunes caches and machine size per job. Runs only for repositories of GitHub organizations.
endpoint: unverified: no public API endpoint stated on the pages read
tooling: hosted Linux runners for GitHub Actions; per-job machines destroyed when the job ends
chaining: a GitHub Actions workflow on a Graphide runner label runs on a per-job machine, with the vendor's agents tuning caches and test splits

limits.value: trial ends at 7 days or USD 10 of CI usage, whichever comes first, or when the vendor contacts the account
one free trial per person and per card; a card is required at checkout
a fixed monthly price replaces the trial, quoted from usage; the price may change if monthly usage rises more than 60% from the starting level

binding_note: a card and a vendor quote gate every account after the 7-day or USD 10 trial, so there is no standing free runner minute allowance

identity_cost.detail: a card is required at checkout for the trial; the page states one free trial per person and per card

evidence.quote: Put in a card at checkout; nothing is charged. The trial lasts 7 days or $10 of CI usage, whichever comes first, or until we contact you.
evidence.proved: the trial lasts 7 days or USD 10 with a card at checkout

evidence.quote: Graphide CI is a service, not a plan to pick. You get our runners, plus a team of AI agents that tunes each job and keeps it fast as your code changes. You pay one fixed monthly price, which we quote from what you run today.
evidence.proved: a fixed monthly quote follows the trial

notes: A hosted GitHub Actions runner service with agent-driven CI tuning. The trial is metered by time and dollars and ends after 7 days or USD 10; the ongoing price is a quote, not a published rate.
